span.p:
API REST
[Container: Node.js 22 · TypeScript · Express 5]
Valida entrada, autentica (API key / HMAC), aplica rate limit,
expõe leads, vendedores e webhook.
Persiste o evento no MySQL antes de responder 202

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MySQL 8
[Banco: InnoDB · READ COMMITTED]
Fonte da verdade: sellers, leads,
webhook_events (inbox) e lead_events

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Redis 7
[Fila: Streams + consumer group · AOF]
fila de webhooks e contadores do rate limit

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Worker de webhooks
[Container: Node.js 22 · TypeScript]
processo separado (ou inline na API)
Consome o stream, faz retry com backoff, recupera mensagens órfãs,
re-enfileira eventos vencidos e atribui leads represados

job de uso único: migrations com
GET_LOCK e checksum
